# RedNote Video Downloader

> Free online tool to download RedNote (Xiaohongshu / 小红书) videos without watermark in HD, Full HD, and 4K quality. No signup required. Also supports Live Photos and image albums.

## What This Site Does

RedNote Video Downloader is a free web-based tool that extracts and downloads videos from Xiaohongshu (RedNote). Users paste a RedNote link (xiaohongshu.com or xhslink.com), choose a quality (720p HD, 1080p Full HD, or 2160p 4K), and download the video without watermark. The tool also supports Live Photos (animated images with embedded video) and image album downloads.
